Coronavirus (COVID-19): Find support for your business

Individuals and families

Health

Read the latest information about COVID-19 from Public Health Wales.

See the latest advice from NHS Direct Wales and use the Coronavirus COVID-19 Symptom Checker.

Latest coronavirus restrictions in Wales

Read the Welsh Government’s guidance and frequently asked questions about current restrictions in Wales.

Coronavirus and the law in Wales

Read information about how the law is being applied to tackle COVID-19 and where coronavirus laws are different in Wales.

Testing in Wales

Read details about the Welsh Government’s approach to testing for COVID-19 in Wales.

Guidance for employees

Read all the latest guidance for employees including details about Statutory Sick Pay and Universal Credit.

Travel

Find out all the latest travel advice for people in Wales via the Welsh Government website.

Education

Find the latest information on schools and educational settings via the Welsh Government website.

Housing

More information about housing issues during the pandemic can be found on the Welsh Government website.

Community services and support

Read more about how community services are affected by the pandemic and access support via the Welsh Government website.

Volunteering

Find guidance on COVID-19 volunteering in Wales by visiting the Welsh Government website.

Visit the Health Education and Improvement Wales website for further information about the COVID-19 volunteer vaccination programme to support in a variety of different roles.

Find out about volunteering opportunities in Wales via the Welsh Government website.

Businesses

General guidance for employers

The Welsh Government has published guidance for businesses and employers including details about your responsibilities as an employer and how to implement physical distancing in the workplace.

You can also stay up to date with information about the reopening of businesses and premises via the Welsh Government’s website.

Find coronavirus financial support for your business

Use the business support finder to see what support is available for you and your business.
